moduleSeedOrdinalFormula.indexRange: g and i are exact u32 values; bits 40..47 identify the module category and bits 56..63 remain reserved for sequenceKindU64

permutation.sequenceScope: independently permute each expanded module's imports, declarations, references, relations, and geometry list with that module's moduleSeedOrdinalU64; empty and singleton lists still use the same defined seed but perform no swap

candidateRegistry.componentVersionRule: standard-library components bind environment.rustc, local-workspace components bind sourceCommit, and crates-io components bind Cargo.lock package ID, version, features and checksum

researchStageModel.storageRule: one contiguous value buffer plus one contiguous payload byte buffer per stage; no per-record heap allocation
researchStageModel.recordOrder: moduleOrdinal, recordKindCode, sourceSpanOrdinal with absentOrdinalU32 first, entityKind, ownerLocalIndex, payloadBytes
payloadPartitionOrder: source spans or typed u32 operands as selected by the stage formula

stringAggregateModel.scope: all UTF-8 strings materialized in sourceInput, typedAst, or hir payload buffers; manifest metadata and sourceToken bytes are excluded
itemOrder: canonical module names in expanded module order
source document keys in expanded module order
import target canonical module names in expanded edge order
one namespace field string per identity declaration in declaration order
profiled identity key strings in declaration and identity-field tag order
source reference spellings in source reference order
shared constant name then shared constant value when present
stringAggregateModel.canonicalModuleOrder: root, shared/common when present, group/{g:08x} by g, unit/{i:08x} by i
stringAggregateModel.stringItemCountFormula: moduleCount + sourceDocumentCount + importEdgeCount + identityDeclarationCount + profiledKeyOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.sharedConstantStringItemCount
stringAggregateModel.maximumStringBytesFormula: max(graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumCanonicalModuleNameBytes, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumSourceDocumentKeyBytes, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumImportTargetModuleNameBytes, 32 when identityDeclarationCount > 0, stringProfile.profiledKeyLengthBytes when profiledKeyOccurrenceCount > 0, 30 when sourceReferenceCount > 0, graphProfile.expectedStringStructure.maximumSharedConstantStringBytes)

aggregateInputFormulas.semanticPayloadByteCount: sum exact payload byte lengths obtained from recordKinds, identityBindings, stringProfile, and the canonical records for this level

recordGranularity: one record per identity field occurrence
one record per source geometry point
typedAst.recordCount: moduleCount + importEdgeCount + sourceDeclarationCount + identityFieldOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + sourceRelationCount + sourceGeometryCount

recordGranularity: one record per identity field occurrence
one record per resolved source reference

one record per unit-checked source geometry point
hir.recordCount: moduleCount + importEdgeCount + symbolCount + identityFieldOccurrenceCount + sourceReferenceCount + sourceRelationCount + sourceGeometryCount

mir.recordGranularity: one record per canonical semantic record before canonical sort and final owner-local ordinal assignment

canonicalLir.recordGranularity: one record per canonical semantic record after canonical sort and final owner-local ordinal assignment

diagnostics.logicalBytes: exact diagnostic stream record bytes excluding the diagnostic stream header

verificationRules: G2 must assert Rust repr(C) size_of for every research record layout before measurement
G2 generator and independent validator must separately enumerate aggregate inputs and evaluate every stage formula
stage record values and payload buffers must be materialized inside the measured pipeline
Rust padding, container capacity, allocator metadata, and process memory are measured separately and never added to logicalBytes

fixtureTemplateRules.nestedAuthoringLaneOrder: roadSections array order, then lanes array order
fixtureTemplateRules.referenceRemap: source ID resolves to entity kind and source array ordinal before timed execution

unitConstruction.movementOrder: entryDirection ascending, then exitDirection ascending excluding exitDirection == entryDirection
unitConstruction.movementIndexFormula: entryDirection * 3 + rank(exitDirection among allowed ascending exits)

moduleOrder: spatial when the selected case contains a SpatialPackage
projectionContract.moduleImports: spatial imports traffic exactly once when present; otherwise no imports

trafficEntitySources.AuthoringLane: roadSections array order then lanes array order
trafficEntitySources.SignalPhase: signals.controllers array order then phases array order

spatialEntitySources.canonicalGeometryPoint: join edges by trafficEdgeId to the traffic LaneEdge declaration, then enumerate centerline.points in traffic LaneEdge declaration order and point array order
spatialEntitySources.crossModuleReference: one spatial-to-traffic LaneEdge binding per joined spatial edge

relationSources.owner-relation: AuthoringLane nesting; Movement.junctionId; ManeuverPath.movementId; ManeuverGate.maneuverPathId; WaitingZone.maneuverPathId; SignalPhase controller nesting; ParkingSpace.areaId; LaneGroup.roadSectionId; RoadCorridor.elements ownership of RoadSection or FacilityBand
relationSources.edge-connection: laneGraph.edges array order then connections array order
relationSources.route-occurrence: routes array order then edgeIds array order
relationSources.access-relation: accessRules array order then participantClassIds array order
relationSources.signal-group-relation: signals.maneuverGates array order where signalControl.kind is group
relationSources.signal-phase-state: signals.controllers, phases, then states array order
relationSources.lane-coverage-occurrence: roadSections, lanes, then edgeIds array order
relationSources.junction-internal-edge-role: maneuverPaths array order then internalEdgeIds array order

identityRule.originalIdUse: resolve current fixture references outside the measured region, then discard original strings
identityRule.identityFields: apply identityBindings in ascending field tag order

sourceReferenceRule.countRule: identity stable-id fields plus every StableId payload field of the projected relation and geometry records plus spatial-to-traffic cross-module bindings

projectionContract.sourceRule: apply sourceSpanRule token ordering and byte lengths, substitute projectionContract.sourceDocumentKeyFormula, and apply researchStageModel to the exact case projection without N scaling
projectionContract.scenarioManifestRule: bind file identity and source lineage only; emit no module, declaration, reference, relation, geometry, semantic, or stage record
projectionContract.unlistedProductionSemantics: not-compared and forbidden from implicit projection

workloads.stageInputRule: apply projectionContract and the selected case projection exactly; compare every aggregate input, domain count, semantic payload byte count, and exactStageExpectation; current fixtures never enter budget or candidate ranking

compilerControlledLowerBound.fixedOverheadRule: no separate fixed-overhead term exists in protocol v1

guardPredictionContract.integerArithmetic: evaluate checked u128 products; compute ceiling division from quotient and nonzero remainder without numerator-plus-denominator-minus-one; convert the final result with u64::try_from
guardPredictionContract.candidateIndependenceRule: the lower bound is derived only from the bound manifest and selected workload level; candidates cannot add, subtract, or measure a private fixed-overhead value

candidateConfiguration.capacityPolicy: fresh process; checked exact lower-bound reserve request before each buffer/table; no stable-capacity reuse

liveByteLimitBaseline.selectedPrivateLimitMode: disable only compiler-controlled-live-byte-count; retain the operational controlled-allocation hard ceiling and every other private limit
liveByteLimitBaseline.agreementRule: the two valid replicas for the same workload/profile/N/B/scale stratum must report exactly equal peakLiveRequestedBytes
liveByteLimitBaseline.exactSelectedValueRule: the common peakLiveRequestedBytes value is the only exact selected value allowed for both paired limit runs in that stratum
liveByteLimitBaseline.candidateIsolationRule: the at-bound and plus-one pair reuses this same baseline candidate configuration; no evaluated candidate may supply its own limit value

inputVariants.construction: the selected canonical scalable workload level without semantic mutation
replace the first canonical route occurrence in every unit with an unknown LaneEdge; retain every record count and source position
attach the first canonical FacilityBand in every unit to the second RoadCorridor while retaining its first owner
replace the first N + 1 canonical route occurrences with independent unknown LaneEdges, set maxDiagnostics=N, and retain all other records

limitPairConstruction.precondition: selected dimension exact value is at least one at calibration and stress scales; diagnostic-count uses the bound diagnostic-producing variant whose exact value is N
limitPairConstruction.atBound: use the canonical workload level and set the selected limit equal to its exact selected dimension value
limitPairConstruction.plusOne: reuse the same canonical workload level and set only the selected limit to exact selected dimension value minus one

selectedValueBasisRules.canonical-level-exact-value: all ordinary count/byte dimensions use the exact formula-derived value from the selected workload level
selectedValueBasisRules.diagnostic-input-count: diagnostic-count uses the exact N diagnostics produced by corridor-missing-reference-per-unit-v1
selectedValueBasisRules.baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1: compiler-controlled-live-byte-count uses only the common value from the two valid compiler-controlled-live-byte-baseline-v1 replicas for the same stratum

success-at-bound.plusOne: fail before allocation, copy, sort, hash, or stage work prohibited by that limit

baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1.atBound: the frozen baseline candidate succeeds with maxCompilerControlledLiveBytes equal to the prescan common peakLiveRequestedBytes
baseline-live-byte-prescan-v1.plusOne: the same baseline candidate fails at the first reservation that would make simultaneous requested bytes exceed common peakLiveRequestedBytes - 1

diagnostic-cap-on-semantic-failure.atBound: compiler-error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-UNKNOWN-REFERENCE with exactly N diagnostics and diagnosticsTruncated=false
diagnostic-cap-on-semantic-failure.plusOne: compiler-error LF-COMP-RESEARCH-E-DIAGNOSTIC-LIMIT when emitting the Nth diagnostic against maxDiagnostics=N-1; retain exactly N-1 diagnostics, set diagnosticsTruncated=true, and start no later compiler stage

inputDigestIncludes: canonical ordered source value records and payload bytes after applying the input variant
selected value basis and any baseline measurement run IDs

failureCases.mutation: replace the first canonical route occurrence in every unit with an unknown LaneEdge
attach the first canonical FacilityBand in every unit to a second RoadCorridor
set maxDiagnostics=N and create N+1 independent unknown references
